independent_computation.step_1_identify_the_only_computable_dama: The scenario names two items. Black Cleaver authors no damage event (S2); Bloodsong's Spellblade is the one damage term either item contributes, and it is a pure '100% base AD' bonus-physical on-hit (S1, S3). A raw_damage leaf in a 'cleaver_bloodsong' scenario that equals a champion's base AD exactly is the signature of that proc: it carries NO bonus-AD term, so it is the one number in the fight that can land exactly on a base-stat value.
independent_computation.step_2_base_ad_law: base_AD(L) = flat + growth·(L−1)·(0.7025 + 0.0175·(L−1))  [S4]. At L=18 the bracket is exactly 1.0, so base_AD(18) = flat + 17·growth.

step_3_evaluate_the_old_value.conclusion: 128.9 = 100% × base AD for a legal production attacker at a legal level (Hecarim at 18 to the digit; Maokai/Pantheon/Draven/Kindred at the level-20 top-lane cap). It is exactly the value S1 prescribes.

step_4_evaluate_the_new_value.claim_tested: Is 53.4 attainable as any Spellblade proc, i.e. 53.4 = k · base_AD(L) for k in {0.75, 1.00, 1.25, 1.50, 1.80, 2.00} (S7)?
step_4_evaluate_the_new_value.sweep: All 173 champions in data/champions.json × levels 1..20 × all six Spellblade coefficients, tolerance ±0.05.
step_4_evaluate_the_new_value.result_at_fight_levels: ZERO matches at any level ≥ 11. The only matches at all are at levels 2-10 (e.g. Karthus L4 at 100%: 53.361; Karma/Renata/Sona L3 at 100%: 53.425; Karthus L10 / Miss Fortune L9 / Nautilus L5 at 75%). No golden combat scenario in this cache runs a participant at level 3-4 (the practice corpus in data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json is uniformly level 18).
step_4_evaluate_the_new_value.why_it_is_impossible_at_18_20: The smallest base AD at L18 in the whole cache is Senna's 50.0 (flat 50, growth 0); the next-smallest is Bel'Veth at 80.5, then Orianna 88.2. There is no champion between 50.0 and 80.5, so no champion's 100% proc can be 53.4, and 53.4/0.75 = 71.2, 53.4/1.25 = 42.7, 53.4/1.5 = 35.6, 53.4/1.8 = 29.7, 53.4/2.0 = 26.7 are all below the L18 floor as well.
step_4_evaluate_the_new_value.amp_check: Bloodsong's own Expose Weakness (8% melee / 5% ranged, S1/S3) cannot bridge the gap either: 128.9/1.08 = 119.35 and 128.9·(5/8) = 80.6, neither of which is 53.4; and the ratio 53.4/128.9 = 0.4143 matches no coefficient, amp, or melee/ranged split anywhere in the cached item text.
step_4_evaluate_the_new_value.conclusion: 53.4 cannot be produced by Bloodsong's Spellblade — or by ANY spellblade item — for any champion at any level a golden fight uses.

independent_computation.step_5_correct_value: For the wielder whose base AD reproduces the old leaf (Hecarim at level 18, or Maokai/Pantheon/Draven/Kindred at the level-20 cap), the Bloodsong Spellblade raw damage is 100% × base AD = 128.9. The old value matches the wiki formula exactly; the new value matches nothing derivable from the cache.

confidence_and_caveats.load_bearing_assumption: That events[46] is (still) the Bloodsong Spellblade proc. The scenario definition lives in scripts//tests/ which this oracle is forbidden to read, so event identity was inferred, not observed. The inference rests on: (a) Bloodsong is the only damage source either named item contributes (S2 rules Black Cleaver out); (b) a Spellblade proc is the only fight term with no bonus-AD component, hence the only one that can land exactly on a base-stat value; (c) 128.9 IS exactly such a value for a fully-modeled named module (S5, S6).
confidence_and_caveats.alternative_reading_considered: If the change removed the proc event entirely (e.g. Bloodsong withheld from a non-support wielder under the item_source rules), events[46] would now hold a DIFFERENT event and the leaf comparison would be an index shift rather than a value change. In that case the new number is not wrong so much as unanchored — but it still cannot be the Bloodsong proc the leaf used to hold, and nothing in data/ produces 53.4 for this scenario's named items. This does not change the verdict that 53.4 is not the correct value of a Bloodsong-proc leaf; it is the one scenario in which 'old_value_correct' would understate the situation.
checks_that_came_back_negative: 53.4 is not any champion's base AD at L18 or L20 (nor total AD with Black Cleaver's +40).
53.4 is not any keystone damage in data/runes.json at L18/L20 (Press the Attack 160.0, Electrocute 240.0, Aery 50.0, Comet 100.0).

53.4 is not reachable by any champion ability row in data/champions.json evaluated at L18 with bonus AD in {0, 40, 55, 95} and AP = 0 (only near-misses: Shaco E per-level 53.38, Yunara W rank 1 53.4 — neither champion is coupled to either named item, and Yunara's W is unrelated to a cleaver/bloodsong scenario).

53.4 is not reachable by scaling a spellblade proc by any on-hit effectiveness in data/onhit-matrix.json (0.25 / 0.30 / 0.75): 53.4/0.25 = 213.6, /0.30 = 178.0, /0.75 = 71.2 — none is a base AD at L18/L20.
grep of the whole data/ tree for the literals '53.4' and '128.9' returns nothing, so neither number is a pinned constant anywhere in the cache.
